verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a government incorporation service that collects personal and company data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question. The evidence pack documents no user-facing control over how long data is kept or how to delete it. The only related item is a notification to authorize data sharing, which is an adjacent consent step, not retention or deletion control, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
